name: León Cathedral
description: León Cathedral rises over the main square of León, Nicaragua, a huge church whose construction ran from 1747 into the early 1800s. Its Guatemalan architect blended Baroque and Neoclassical styles. Inside, plain walls and plentiful daylight contrast with a richly decorated sanctuary vault. Look for the wooden Flemish altarpiece and Antonio Sarria's paintings of the Way of the Cross.
